metadata.title: Missing You — memories with gentle proof
metadata.description: A calm place to write about people you miss. Your words stay private off-chain; a cryptographic proof can be anchored on-chain.

footer.tagline: Missing You — preserving memories with care.

home.headline: Preserve a memory with proof that it existed.
home.subhead: A calm place for memories that matter. Keep your words private off-chain, and anchor only the proof on-chain so anyone can verify integrity without reading your journal.

step1.title: Write from the heart
step1.body: Capture what you remember in a quiet, unhurried editor. Your words are stored securely off-chain.

step2.title: Create a canonical proof
step2.body: We build a stable fingerprint of your entry — not the prose itself — so the same memory always produces the same hash.

step3.title: Anchor when you are ready
step3.body: Optionally anchor that fingerprint on-chain. Later, anyone can verify the memory against the blockchain without seeing private content.

privacy.title: Privacy-first by design
privacy.body: Journal content stays off-chain. The chain holds only identifiers and cryptographic commitments — never your full letter, story, or diary entry.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Your full memory text remains off-chain in secure storage.

proof.title: Proof you can trust
proof.body: A canonical hash is anchored on-chain so authenticity is verifiable.

share.title: Share only when ready
share.body: Publish a gentle public page while keeping private drafts hidden.

flow.title: A clear flow, from feeling to proof
flow.body: Each step is designed to feel simple, calm, and trustworthy.

write.title: Write
write.body: Capture your memory in your own words.

save.title: Save off-chain
save.body: Store full content privately in the database.

anchor.title: Anchor proof
anchor.body: Send only hash metadata to the chain.

share.title: Choose visibility
share.body: Keep private or enable a public page.

verify.title: Verify later
verify.body: Compare proof details at any time.

journey.title: A gentle journey for memories that matter
journey.body: Missing You blends emotional writing with practical trust. You write freely, choose when to anchor proof, and share only if or when it feels right.

points.two: Anchor only proof, never full journal text.

card.draftBody: "I still hear your laugh on rainy days."

onChain.q: Is my full memory content on-chain?
onChain.a: No. Only proof metadata is anchored on-chain; full content stays off-chain.

stored.a: A memory key, content hash, owner/time metadata, and shareability state.

private.q: Can I keep a memory private forever?
private.a: Yes. Private memories remain owner-only unless you choose to share.
